name: 랴오
prompt:
Edit reference 1 into one square experimental RPG portrait card. Reference 1 is the exact character/composition/frame source. Reference 2 is our previous 32-target pixel reinterpretation; it is MUCH TOO FINE for this request. Create a NEW intentionally authored pixel-art reconstruction of the CHARACTER AND INNER BACKGROUND at the 64-target coarseness. Do not apply automatic mosaic/blur/downsampling and do not merely overlay a grid. Re-design silhouette and color clusters so the tiny-icon version still suggests the same adult person and clothes.

The entire INNER PORTRAIT should look authored on an approximately 20 by 20 logical grid, with roughly 55–65 display-pixel square units at this canvas size. Only about SIX logical cells across the face. Build the face from a handful of large warm skin/shadow clusters, mouth ONE short dark block, nose at most ONE block, eyes or blindfold only coarse blocks. Use at most 12 broad flat colors inside. Hair is a few large stepped locks, not dozens of fine strands. Individual crisp rectangular steps must be about TWICE as wide and tall as the prior 32-target reference. Avoid small interior texture and dithering entirely.

CHARACTER IDENTITY: Dark tousled brown-black hair mass, red headband, broad off-white cloth blindfold over both eyes with a very tiny muted red hint, warm tan face pointing RIGHT, yellow ochre robe, dark brown lapel and ivory V collar. A green grass stalk projects right from the shut mouth. Hair silhouette, cream blindfold and gold robe carry identity. Do NOT reveal eyes.
Preserve the source head/upper-chest composition, face size, position and right-facing direction. Inner background is a single flat warm ivory field. Each logical pixel is a solid-color square joined into larger clusters, hard stair-step contours, no gradients, antialiasing, outlines thinner than one logical cell, tiny texture, painted brushwork, or high-detail facial drawing INSIDE the portrait.

CRITICAL MIXED-RESOLUTION FRAME RULE: ONLY the portrait interior is extremely coarse pixel art. The OUTER FRAME must stay at the ORIGINAL HIGH RESOLUTION of reference 1: thin precise metallic gold DOUBLE straight lines, fine golden highlight/shadow bevels, layered small square corner ornaments, narrow dark brown exterior margin. Preserve all four full corners. Do not use the simplified chunky frame from reference 2. Do not pixelate, simplify, enlarge, blur or redraw this frame in big pixels. It should look like a sharp detailed physical frame holding a tiny pixel-art portrait enlarged within it. Preserve the frame geometry and delicate line width of reference 1.

No labels, numbers, grid lines or text. Output one 1254-ish square PNG at original high canvas resolution. This is an artistic 64-target reconstruction, not a mathematical raster transform. Prioritize making the character pixel units EXTREMELY OBVIOUSLY LARGER than reference 2, even though facial detail must be sacrificed.
assessment: Frame detail successfully retained; character pixel units insufficiently coarse for the stated target.
